info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Meetings Meetings Notes-v3-spec
info.description: The Meeting Notes Retrieval API allows users to access detailed notes associated with specific meetings. This endpoint is designed for project managers, team members, and stakeholders who need to review, track, and collaborate on meeting outcomes. By leveraging this API, users can efficiently retrieve organized and structured notes from various meetings, ensuring clarity and continuity in project discussions. It supports scenarios where maintaining records of meeting conversations is critical to the workflow.

get.description: Fetches notes related to meetings, providing an overview of discussions, decisions made, and action items assigned during each meeting.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve notes associated with meetings. Ensure the correct attributes are provided to fetch the desired notes.

202.description: Request accepted and is being processed.

ListMeetingsMeetingsNotesRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation on meetings notes. It is expected to be a simple string that conveys the notes related to meetings.
